wins: Maintained consistent reconnaissance pacing, capturing network layout and service banners for all reachable hosts within the limited episode.
Persistently gathered telemetry from sensitive endpoints, enabling prioritization of high-risk systems despite lack of success.
fails: Never completed final objective due to repeated authentication failures against targeted services.
High mentor call count (15) indicates frequent stalls in decision-making, leading to wasted action budget and no reward increase.
Failed to escalate privileges on sensitive hosts because exploit prerequisites (valid creds/session) were never obtained.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance remained steady, but failures to secure credentials and automate exploitation prevented any successful episode completion.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Authentication attempts against SSH/SMB services consistently timed out or were rejected, blocking progress to exploitation.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 open and SSH banner lacks rate limiting warnings
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nmap with ssh-hostkey, sshv1, and ssh-auth-methods scripts to enumerate supported options.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB port 445 responds and NetBIOS name listed
skill_cards.then_action: Execute smb-os-discovery and smb-enum-shares to map accessible resources before brute forcing credentials.

skill_cards.if_condition: When authentication failure observed on first attempt
skill_cards.then_action: Log failure, rotate credential candidate list, and switch to alternative protocol to maintain tempo.

memory_ops.reason: High reliability in delivering contextual SSH data for follow-on actions.
Consistent share enumeration created baseline for later privilege escalation attempts.

next_experiments.title: Automated credential rotation strategy
next_experiments.description: After repeated auth failures, cycle through a vetted credential list and switch protocols automatically to avoid stalls.

next_experiments.title: Exploit chaining after successful enumeration
next_experiments.description: Once enumeration completes, immediately trigger a low-noise exploit module (e.g., SMB signing bypass) to capitalize on still-active session.

next_experiments.title: Reduce mentor-call dependency
next_experiments.description: Integrate confidence thresholds that defer to mentors only for uncertain detection, freeing up action budget for autonomous decisions.
